business_problem: Tabcorp needed a better way to support multichannel wagering personalization, responsible gaming, and enterprise generative AI because fragmented systems delayed customer insight, compliance preparation, and knowledge access across marketing, operations, and safer gambling workflows.
solution_summary: Tabcorp uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support multichannel wagering personalization, responsible gaming, and enterprise generative AI. The implementation replaced a legacy state where fragmented systems delayed customer insight, compliance preparation, and knowledge access across marketing, operations, and safer gambling workflows. Customer wagering data and marketing content move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver personalized generosity recommendations and responsible gambling interventions.
